      "message": "src: keep ALS store in AsyncResource::MakeCallback\n\nAsyncResource saves the async context frame when it is created, and\nMakeCallback() enters it with async_context_frame::Scope.   "body": "flow() for a synchronous byte-mode pipe spends most of its time in the general `read()` path: take one prefetched chunk out of a holey buffer, then call `_read()` for the next one. A nested `read()` puts the chunk back on the buffer.
